map.📋 食品安全法要点: 📋 Key Points of the Food Safety Law
map.生产不符合食品安全标准的食品或者经营明知是不符合食品安全标准的食品，消费者除要求: Where food failing safety standards is produced, or food known to fail them is sold, the consumer may claim compensation for the loss and also demand ten times the price or three times the loss from the producer or seller
map.增加赔偿的金额不足一千元的，为一千元: Where the additional compensation is under ¥1,000, it is ¥1,000
map.食品的标签、说明书存在不影响食品安全且不会对消费者造成误导的瑕疵的除外: Defects in a label or in the instructions that do not affect food safety and do not mislead the consumer are excluded
map.消费者需证明食品不符合标准、购买事实；生产者/经营者需举证符合标准: The consumer must prove that the food fails the standards and that it was bought; the producer or seller must prove compliance
map.可向生产者或销售者任一方主张赔偿，首负责任制先行赔付: The claim may be brought against either the producer or the seller, who must pay first under the primary-responsibility rule
map.📚 深度解析：食品安全退一赔十计算器: 📚 In-depth: Food Safety Refund plus Tenfold Damages
map.购买到不符合食品安全标准的食品，按《食品安全法》计算十倍赔偿。: For food that fails safety standards, compute the tenfold award under the Food Safety Law.
map.价款十倍不足 1000 元的，按 1000 元保底赔偿。: Where ten times the price is under ¥1,000, a floor of ¥1,000 applies.
map.造成人身损害的，可另行主张损失三倍赔偿（消法第 55 条第 2 款）。: Where personal injury is caused, three times the loss may be claimed separately under Article 55(2) of the Consumer Law.
map.赔偿 = 200 × 10 = 2000 元（保底 1000 元）；加上退货退款: Damages = 200 × 10 = ¥2,000 (¥1,000 floor); including the refund, ¥2,200 may be claimed in all.
map.赔偿 = 50 × 10 = 500 元，不足 1000 元按保底 1000 元: Damages = 50 × 10 = ¥500, below the floor, so ¥1,000 is awarded.
map.标签瑕疵也能十倍赔偿吗？: Does a labelling defect also give tenfold damages?
map.若仅属标签瑕疵但不影响食品安全且不会误导，法院可能不支持十倍；明知不符合安全标准: Where the defect is only in the label, does not affect safety and is not misleading, a court may refuse tenfold; the rule applies to knowingly dealing in food that fails safety standards, which must be proved on the facts.
map.和退一赔三冲突吗？: Does it conflict with refund plus triple?
map.食品领域优先适用食安法退一赔十；若同时构成消费欺诈且造成人身损害，可就损失主张消: In the food field the Food Safety Law rule of refund plus tenfold applies first; where consumer fraud and personal injury are also present, three times the loss may be claimed under the Consumer Law. Each is dealt with according to the claim made.
map.关于「食品安全退一赔十计算器」: About "Food Safety Refund plus Tenfold Damages"
map.食品安全退一赔十计算器。法律合规工具，基于现行法律法规计算，数据本地处理。: Food Safety Refund plus Tenfold Damages. A legal compliance tool that computes under current laws and regulations, with all data processed locally.
map.仅属标签瑕疵：不影响食品安全且不误导消费者（第148条例外，不适用十倍赔偿）: Label defect only: does not affect food safety and does not mislead consumers (Article 148 exception, tenfold damages do not apply)
map.食品安全惩罚性赔偿：退还货款 = 价款；十倍赔偿 = max(价款×10, 10: Food safety punitive damages: refund = price paid; tenfold compensation = max(price × 10, 1000) (a floor of 1,000 CNY when below that); triple damages for losses = if losses are ticked, losses × 3, otherwise 0; punitive damages = max(tenfold, triple); total claimable = price + (if ticked) losses + punitive damages. Article 148 exception: when the issue type is label/instructions problem and label defect only (does not affect food safety and is not misleading) is ticked, the tenfold compensation is zeroed and only the price is refunded. Validation: non-numbers fall back to 0, and if the result contains NaN/Infinity it prompts to check the inputs. Rule: when tenfold compensation uses the floor (≤ 1,000 CNY) a floor badge is shown; if seller knowingly is not ticked and the price > 0, an evidence reminder is given.
